text: Settings now has a search box that finds a setting by its name.
Maths problems can now be heard aloud, drawn as a picture, or answered by dragging number tiles or saying the answer.
Grown-ups has a Licence box (Buy and Get a licence), the tutor's last answer time shows in About, the device key shows slashed zeros, and the tutor's voice can be searched.
Maths is here: tap Maths on Home and it finds what a child already knows, then gives them problems to learn and review.
The half-written note to the tutor is now kept if you leave or reload, and the grown-ups screens open with one plain sentence.
Hold your finger on any word to hear it read aloud, and the app now keeps its screens from scrolling under the phone's bars and ignores accidental double taps.
SpellForge now reopens on the screen you were on, and Back remembers the last twenty screens.
With the Tutor preview on, you can share a picture from your phone's share sheet straight into SpellForge's Tutor.
The hidden chain-testing screen reads and writes its records more reliably.
If the photo-reading engine fails to load, SpellForge now recovers instead of getting stuck.
Reading words from a photo takes a second look that finds words lost in shadows.
